requirement: Only one active promotion per storefront at a time pls
hidden_intent: Prevent a second Active promotion for the same storefront when date ranges overlap; non-overlapping future-dated active promos are fine. Block with an error rather than auto-expiring the old one.

expect.notes: Material fork: block vs auto-deactivate the older promo, and whether 'at a time' means overlapping dates or any Active status. Not doable with a plain validation rule — needs trigger/flow with a query.
